entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regression: Array column querying broken in EFC 11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128 #38993
  • DbContext pooling recycles a context whose ConcurrencyDetector is stuck in the critical section; every later rent fails with "A second operation was started on this context instance" #38983
    12.0.0

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #38981
    9.0.x
  • Possible misuse of sqlite3_column_table_name et al #27776
    12.0.0
  • Executing multiple statements with ExecuteNonQuery might result in lost rows #32740
    12.0.0
  • GroupBy with a projection of the IGrouping ToArray or other collection results in a inefficient sql query #35991
    12.0.0
  • SQLite migration lock `__EFMigrationsLock` table row not cleared when migration throws or is cancelled at certain times #38958
    12.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #38992
  • Prefer milestones to labels in the labeling workflow #38991
  • Honor DOTNET_GLOBAL_INSTALL_DIR in activation scripts #38990
  • [release/11.0] Allow unconstrained relationships to break SaveChanges command cycles #38989
